title: Project 1 · Counter + Todo App
summary: Classic starter: reactive counter plus a todo list exercising refs, computed, components and emits.
requirements: Counter with increment/decrement and a derived 'double' readout (computed, not watched)
TodoInput component emitting add(text); list renders via v-for with keys
Toggle done + remove; footer shows 'n left' via computed filter
No prop mutation anywhere — events up, data down
